visual_thesis: Reading a molecular structure is different from predicting its properties. At phone scale distinguish evidence, prediction and withheld experimental comparison; full size exposes separate reconstruction, reasoning, selection and prediction tasks, without implying drug discovery.
mechanism_metaphor: A single continuous oblique scientific specimen section, not a machine. At left a folded research archive exposes a plain source sheet, a connected abstract molecular scaffold and a distinct reconstructed scaffold. At center a broad translucent analytical section contains a structure-match layer, an evidence-explanation layer and two diverging property tracks: cell activity and permeability/metabolism are conceptual unnumbered assay shapes. At right a withheld-evidence sleeve slides beside the predicted specimen, with paired comparison tabs, a ranking tray and a numerical-prediction specimen. The separate experimental sleeve is visibly not part of model input. Twelve meaningful roles: source sheet, input scaffold, reconstructed scaffold, structure comparison, explanation layer, activity path, permeability path, metabolism path, proposed ranking, numerical prediction specimen, withheld evidence sleeve and comparison join. No literal chemical formula, invented compound identity, data plot, dial or medical outcome.
